objective_value: <float> Total system travel time, combining vehicle time spent traversing links and traveler time spent waiting at origins.
y: <dict, key: '{from_node}|{via_node}|{to_node}|{destination_centroid}|{time_step}'> Number of vehicles destined for a given centroid that turn from an incoming link onto a successor link at a given time step.
y_centroid: <dict, key: '{centroid}|{junction}|{destination_centroid}|{time_step}'> Number of vehicles departing a centroid via its outgoing connector toward a given destination at a given time step.
N_U: <dict, key: '{from_node}|{to_node}|{destination_centroid}|{time_step}'> Cumulative count of vehicles destined for a given centroid that have entered the upstream end of a link by a given time step.
N_D: <dict, key: '{from_node}|{to_node}|{destination_centroid}|{time_step}'> Cumulative count of vehicles destined for a given centroid that have exited the downstream end of a link by a given time step.
p: <dict, key: '{centroid}|{time_step}'> Number of vehicles parked at a centroid at a given time step.
e: <dict, key: '{origin_centroid}|{destination_centroid}|{time_step}'> Number of travelers picked up at an origin centroid heading to a given destination at a given time step.
omega: <dict, key: '{origin_centroid}|{destination_centroid}|{time_step}'> Number of travelers waiting at an origin centroid for service to a given destination at a given time step.
